description: Reviewed action routing and anchored transfer hypotheses. Update explicitly when a named executed failure reopens discovery. Unknown capabilities fail closed to await_external; prose frequency never generates queries. CAP-014/CAP-015 search reopens only through reviewed search_gate state plus a repository-relative, SHA-256-bound executed evidence receipt identifying the named gap and next search question.
